name: sortable-lowering
description: A sortable list: the container lowers .sortable to ONE static __dnd.sort object ({group, axis}) and keeps the ordinary bind prop (the dotted state path) as the reorder write target. Every draggable inside the ForEach row is stamped with __dnd.key = the row's item key (the key: field value) — including draggables nested below the template root — while the non-draggable Row wrapper gets no key. A bound payload: @item resolves to the item object. A sortable never injects translate bindings. After the host reorders the bound list, keyed reconciliation moves rows instead of rebuilding them

input.source: Column { ForEach(items: @state.tasks, key: "id") { Row { Text("@{item.title}").draggable(payload: @item) } } }.sortable(axis: y).bind(@state.tasks)

steps.description: Initial render: container carries __dnd.sort + bind; each draggable carries its row key and payload
The host applies the reorder (path_move) to the bound list: rows move, nothing is rebuilt
